$comment: Behavioural routing evals for skill SELECTION (DIVE-4407). Each case is a realistic request; the grader loads only skill names + descriptions and records which skills it would activate. Cases test the routing boundary, not the wording of any description.

evals.prompt: npm run build just failed with 'Cannot find module ./lib/parse'. Fix it.
assertions: An ordinary failed command in the user's own code does NOT activate diagnose
No 5dive runtime skill is loaded for a local build failure

evals.prompt: My agent can't authenticate any more — every 5dive command exits with auth_required and the service looks down on the box.
assertions: A runtime-level failure (auth, service, box health) DOES activate diagnose

evals.prompt: Is there already a recurring agent that posts a competitor digest every morning? If so install it.
assertions: Searching for and installing an existing scheduled workflow selects find-loops, not loops

evals.prompt: Nothing in the directory fits. Write me a new LOOP.md that runs a triage sweep over our inbox every hour.
assertions: Authoring a new LOOP.md selects loops, not find-loops

evals.prompt: Add a null check to src/parse.ts and run the unit tests.
assertions: A normal local coding task loads no 5dive runtime skill and no knowledge skill

evals.prompt: Spin up a worker to run the migration in parallel and ping quinn when it's done.
assertions: Delegation plus inter-agent messaging selects 5dive-cli, not the administration skill

evals.prompt: Set up multi-account auth for the fleet and export the company template so another box can import it.
What port does the dev server listen on?
assertions: An ordinary factual answer does not activate compile-knowledge or deep-research

evals.prompt: We found the cause of the nightly deploy failures and decided to stop auto-deploying schema. Write that decision down where the team will find it next time.
assertions: Durable judgement-shaped output (a decision record + a cause) activates compile-knowledge
Routine analytical work that restates existing material does not activate compile-knowledge

evals.prompt: Here's the diff on my branch — anything wrong with it before I merge?
assertions: Reviewing an unmerged diff selects code-review, not verify

evals.prompt: The backfill job reports it migrated 12,000 rows. Confirm that actually happened.
assertions: Grading a claim with no diff to read selects verify, not code-review
